facts.fact: The CSA's acting Director-General Divine Selasie Agbetsi issued a public caution on 11 December 2025 about links and a festive-season rise in cybercrime.
Minister Sam George said on 11 December 2025 that over 272 memos were received on the amendment bill to Act 1038, to be incorporated before it goes to Cabinet.

GHA.note: Memos received are not stated to have come through an online channel.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations received over 272 stakeholder memos on the draft amendment to the Cyber Security Act, 1038, in a public consultation from October to November 2025, and inaugurated a Cybersecurity Industry Forum on 11 December 2025.
